Add images at cell centroids

Source: R/annotate.R
vm_add_images.Rd

Places an image (logo, icon, flag, photo) at the centroid of each cell. Requires the ggimage package.

Usage

vm_add_images(
  p,
  vm = NULL,
  image,
  size = 0.05,
  by = "width",
  asp = 1,
  alpha = 1,
  nudge_x = 0,
  nudge_y = 0,
  cells = NULL
)

Arguments

p

A ggplot from autoplot.voronoi_map() / ggvmap().

vm

Optional voronoi_map; taken from p when omitted.

image

Image paths or URLs: length-n (cell order), named by cell label, or length 1. NA entries are skipped.

size

Image size as a fraction of the plot. Default 0.05.

by

Size dimension passed to ggimage::geom_image(): "width" (default) or "height".

asp

Aspect-ratio correction passed to ggimage::geom_image(). Default 1.

alpha

Image opacity. Default 1.

nudge_x, nudge_y

Position offset in data units. Default 0.

cells

Optional subset of cell labels to annotate.

Value

The ggplot with an image layer added.
